steps.title: HAK//SKILL AVAILABLE
messages: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest

steps.text: Our date today ☀️
Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
No 😭
I just don't want our park date getting rained on
We'd find somewhere to hide
You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
I was going to do that in good weather too
Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
How does your leg feel this morning?
Strange without the cast
I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
Is it hurting?
A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
Then we're doing the short walk today
There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
You already have a bench picked out?
Yes. Very advanced date planning
I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
A balanced relationship 😌
Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
Save some room for tonight
What are you making?
Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
You remembered dessert. Excellent start
You'll have to wait to find out what it is
Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
The outfit?
I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
And yes, I bought your other choice too
Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
Meet me at the park entrance at three?
Three it is
Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
I won't
See you this afternoon, love ❤️
